title: Tokenized Treasury Funds Reach $14.69 Billion as Collateral Frictions Persist
why_it_matters: The asset total shows expanding onchain Treasury supply, but institutional use depends on operational integration that can move collateral reliably without excess buffers.
caption:
RWA WIRE // MARKETS

Tokenized Treasury Funds Reach $14.69 Billion as Collateral Frictions Persist

TokenPost reported $14.69 billion across 117 tokenized Treasury products on October 16, while an earlier Nasdaq survey documented persistent collateral-processing frictions.
